verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents creating tasks directly from plain-language GitHub, Linear and Jira issues. It also offers structured workflows (RPI, PRD-Oriented, Oneshot) that suggest a path from a described change to planned implementation work. However, no doc shows a free-text description being automatically decomposed or scoped into a defined implementation task. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic scoping or spec generation from a plain-language description, details of what the RPI/PRD workflows produce, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have it automatically turned into a scoped implementation task

citations.quote: Connect GitHub to create HumanLayer tasks from issues and link task artifacts back to the source issue.
Connect Linear so HumanLayer can create tasks from Linear issues, sync issue status, and link HumanLayer artifacts back to the source issue.
A change with unclear behavior or code shape needs more review before implementation.
